Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Raid Buff Off (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Cancel selected buffs during combat in selected areas.
Description: Global client. Checkbox lists select cancellable buffs and duty/territory allowlists. Buffs are cancelled only while enabled, in a selected area, and in combat. DTR left-click toggles ON/OFF; right-click opens settings. Defaults to OFF with empty selections. Uses the game's status-off path. Open /rbo.
Changelog: 0.1.0.0: Initial testing release with DTR left-click ON/OFF, right-click settings, buff checkboxes, area allowlists and combat-only cancellation. Requires in-game testing.
